title: What Is a Golden Spike? Quiz
description: Watched the channel intro? Do you know what a "golden spike" means in geology?

questions.question: What is the official abbreviation for a geological "golden spike"?
questions.explanation: GSSP stands for Global Boundary Stratotype Section and Point, nicknamed the "golden spike".

questions.question: What does a golden spike do?
options: Marks the location of a gold mine
Marks the boundary between geological time periods in real rock layers, like an anchor on a timeline
questions.explanation: A golden spike is a reference point in an actual rock section that the whole world uses to divide Earth's history into periods.

questions.question: Why is the channel called GoldenSpike?
options: Because gold is a nice colour
To be like a golden spike: giving you the core, standard knowledge
questions.explanation: A golden spike stands for a standard and an anchor point. The channel aims to boil complex geology down to the key ideas in 3–5 minute videos.
